title: 第9章 杀出重围第10章 一成剑意
content_zh:
“可恶！”
宋时于气得牙根都痒，他并没有看清牧帆的身影，但是已经猜到了是牧帆。
除了被他们围困在蛮牛山脉中的牧帆，还有谁会对他出手？
然而眼前死盯着他的黑月虎，让宋时于不敢有任何的分心。
黑月虎明显已经被激怒，发起凛冽的攻势，庞大的身躯包裹着一层灵气，防御力非常强，仿佛刀枪不入。
宋时于的战刀劈上去，就连灵气防御也破不开。
在被激怒的黑月虎接连攻势之下，宋时于难以脱身，身上也多出了几处伤口。
蛮牛山脉外围。
宋茗和宋艳迅速冲了出来。
牧常连忙问道：“打斗声是怎么回事？牧帆出现了？”
宋茗摇头，心有余悸，“牧帆没有出现，倒是引来一头二阶黑月虎！”
宋艳脸色还有些苍白，转头望了一眼山脉内部，“五长老还没有回来，不会是难以脱身了吧？”
想起黑月虎的可怕气势，宋艳就感觉后背发凉。
“应该不会。”
宋茗可不想回去了，玄武境的一击，可能就会让他丧命，因此开口：“黑月虎比五长老强不了多少，五长老应该很快就能脱身回来。”
……
宋茗说的确实不假，宋时于确实有好几次脱身的机会，但是都被牧帆破坏了！
每当宋时于冲出来时，总会被牧帆拖延住时间。
对于黑月虎来说，拖延住那么一瞬间，就足够了。
“噗！”

黑月虎找到机会，用音波武技震住宋时于，随后冲上去，一爪子抓在宋时于的胸膛上。
“啊……”
宋时于脸色铁青，狠狠一刀劈向黑月虎的脑袋。
黑月虎轻松跳跃就躲了过去。
哪怕宋时于身上有灵气护体，依旧被抓出深深的爪印，血流不止。
黑月虎继续攻击。
宋时于已经逐渐抵挡不住攻势。
牧帆抓住时机，一剑刺向宋时于的后背。
“老夫就算死，也要拉你小子垫背！”
宋时于又一次感受到身后的寒意，不再理会正面攻来的黑月虎，转身一刀，全力劈向牧帆。
牧帆改刺为挥，剑随心动，惊鸿的剑身仿佛在闪烁。
“噗嗤！”
宋时于眼睁睁看着自己的左臂被一剑切下。
那锐利的剑锋，竟然如此之锋利，灵气防御仿佛不存在！
content_en:
"Damn it!"
Song Shiyu was so angry that his teeth were itching. He didn't see Mu Fan clearly, but he had already guessed that it was Mu Fan.
Besides Mu Fan, who was trapped in the Manniu Mountains by them, who else would take action against him?
However, Song Shiyu did not dare to be distracted by the Black Moon Tiger staring at him.
The Black Moon Tiger was obviously angered and launched a fierce offensive. Its huge body was wrapped in a layer of spiritual energy, and its defense was very strong, as if it was invulnerable.
Song Shiyu's sword slashed at him, and even the aura defense couldn't break through.
Under the enraged Black Moon Tiger's successive attacks, Song Shiyu was unable to escape and suffered several wounds on his body.
Outside the Manniu Mountains.
Song Ming and Song Yan rushed out quickly.
Mu Chang asked quickly: "What's the sound of fighting? Mu Fan appeared?"
Song Ming shook her head, with lingering fear, "Mu Fan didn't show up, but he attracted a second-order Black Moon Tiger!"
Song Yan's face was still a little pale, and she turned her head and looked inside the mountain range, "The fifth elder hasn't come back yet. Isn't it difficult to escape?"
Thinking of the terrifying aura of the Black Moon Tiger, Song Yan felt a chill on her back.
"Probably not."
Song Ming didn't want to go back. A blow from the Xuanwu realm might kill him, so he said: "Black Moon Tiger is not much stronger than the fifth elder. The fifth elder should be able to escape and come back soon."
…
What Song Ming said was indeed true. Song Shiyu did have several chances to escape, but they were all destroyed by Mu Fan!
Whenever Song Shiyu rushed out, he would always be delayed by Mu Fan.
For Black Moon Tiger, delaying for just a moment is enough.
"Poof!"
Black Moon Tiger found an opportunity and used sonic martial arts to shock Song Shiyu, then rushed forward and grabbed Song Shiyu's chest with one claw.
"Ah..."
Song Shiyu's face was livid, and he slashed at Hei Yuehu's head with a knife.
Black Moon Tiger easily jumped and dodged.
Even though Song Shiyu was protected by spiritual energy, he was still scratched with deep claw marks and bleeding.
Black Moon Tiger continued to attack.
Song Shiyu could no longer withstand the attack.
Mu Fan seized the opportunity and stabbed Song Shiyu in the back with his sword.
"Even if I die, I will still support you!"
Song Shiyu once again felt the chill behind him, and ignored the Black Moon Tiger attacking from the front. He turned around and slashed at Mu Fan with all his strength.
Mu Fan changed from stabbing to swinging, the sword moved with his heart, and Jinghong's sword seemed to be flickering.
"Pfft!"
Song Shiyu watched helplessly as his left arm was cut off with a sword.
That sharp sword edge was so sharp that the aura defense seemed to be non-existent!
